name: hcml-portal
description: Runs the checks of both packages from the repository root. It has no dependencies of its own: server/ and web/ are separate npm projects with separate lockfiles, and tools/ uses Node's standard library.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.check: npm run check:api && npm run check:erd && npm run check:styles && npm run check:web && npm run check:docs && npm run check:parity
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check
